description: This file is a Java test class for the PatientIdentifierValidator component within the OpenMRS project. It contains unit tests verifying the correctness of identifier validation logic, including format checks, uniqueness, and validation of associated properties.

classes.name: PatientIdentifierValidatorTest
classes.description: Test class for PatientIdentifierValidator, with multiple unit tests for various validation scenarios.

methods.name: validateIdentifier_shouldFailValidationIfPatientIdentifierIsNull
methods.description: Tests that validation fails if the PatientIdentifier is null.

methods.name: validateIdentifier_shouldPassValidationIfPatientIdentifierIsVoided
methods.description: Tests that a voided PatientIdentifier passes validation.

methods.name: validateIdentifier_shouldFailValidationIfAnotherPatientHasAMatchingIdentifierOfTheSameType
methods.description: Tests validation failure when another patient has a matching identifier of the same type.

methods.name: validateIdentifier_shouldFailValidationIfPatientIdentifierTypeIsNull
methods.description: Tests validation failure when the identifier type is null.

methods.name: checkIdentifierAgainstFormat_shouldFailValidationIfIdentifierIsBlank
methods.description: Tests format validation failure with a blank identifier.

methods.name: checkIdentifierAgainstFormat_shouldFailValidationIfIdentifierDoesNotMatchTheFormat
methods.description: Tests format validation failure for an identifier not matching the regex.

methods.name: checkIdentifierAgainstFormat_shouldPassValidationIfIdentifierMatchesTheFormat
methods.description: Ensures validation passes if identifier matches the regex format.

methods.name: checkIdentifierAgainstFormat_shouldPassValidationIfTheFormatIsBlank
methods.description: Ensures validation passes if format regex is blank.

methods.name: checkIdentifierAgainstValidator_shouldFailValidationIfIdentifierIsBlank
methods.description: Tests failure when identifier is blank during validator check.

methods.name: checkIdentifierAgainstValidator_shouldFailValidationIfIdentifierIsInvalid
methods.description: Tests failure when identifier does not pass the check digit validation.

methods.name: checkIdentifierAgainstValidator_shouldPassValidationIfIdentifierIsValid
methods.description: Tests passing validation with a valid identifier.

methods.name: checkIdentifierAgainstValidator_shouldPassValidationIfValidatorIsNull
methods.description: Ensures validation passes if no validator is provided.

methods.name: validateIdentifier_shouldFailValidationIfIdentifierIsBlank
methods.description: Tests validation failure on blank identifier with specific type.

methods.name: validateIdentifier_shouldPassIfInUseAndIdTypeUniquenessIsSetToNonUnique
methods.description: Validates that duplicate IDs are acceptable if type is set as non-unique.

methods.name: validateIdentifier_shouldPassIfLocationBehaviorIsNotUsedAndLocationIsNull
methods.description: Tests validation pass when location behavior is set to not used and location is null.

methods.name: validateIdentifier_shouldPassIfLocationBehaviorIsRequiredAndLocationIsNull
methods.description: Expects validation failure if location is required but not provided.

methods.name: validate_shouldPassValidationIfFieldLengthsAreCorrect
methods.description: Confirms that identifiers with acceptable field lengths pass validation.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailValidationIfFieldLengthsAreNotCorrect
methods.description: Confirms that overly long identifier fields trigger validation errors.

methods.name: checkIdentifierAgainstFormat_shouldIncludeFormatInErrorMessageIfNoFormatDescriptionIsSpecified
methods.description: Tests that error messages include the format regex if no description is provided.

methods.name: checkIdentifierAgainstFormat_shouldIncludeFormatDescriptionInErrorMessageIfSpecified
methods.description: Tests that error messages include the provided format description.
